匹配键：check（字符串或数组，缺省=全部）、file、rule —— 即 spec 要求的 (check_id, file, rule) 三元组。
可选缩小豁免面的键：by（遮蔽/胜出方规则串）、by_file（遮蔽/胜出方所在 list）。
preventive=true 表示防回归豁免：当前配置本就不该命中，未命中时不计入「未使用豁免」告警。
file / rule / by / by_file 均支持 fnmatch 通配（* ?）。每条必须写 reason。
允许存在的分层放 exemptions；必须持续不存在的规则放 forbidden，A8 命中即 P0 且不可豁免。
kind 可缩小检查子类；pending_decision 只登记尚未裁决的项目，不改变退出码。

forbidden.reason: A single-label public suffix cannot encode service ownership; explicit CN domains and ChinaIP provide the fallback.
A public gTLD cannot be assigned wholesale to one policy.
The public registration boundary cannot override explicitly owned .com.cn services.
googleapis.com is a shared API/tenant namespace; only explicit provider and service endpoints may be owned.
Mozilla add-on control and version-check endpoints have different verified owners; the parent must remain exact.
Apple TV has a specialized media child; the shared parent must not erase that boundary.
